name: Translate to Chinese
description: Translate text from any language into natural Simplified Chinese
promptTemplate:
Translate the following text into natural, fluent Simplified Chinese. Preserve the meaning, tone, and formatting of the original. If the text is already in Chinese, return it unchanged:

"{{input}}"

IMPORTANT: Return ONLY the Chinese translation. Do NOT include any introductory notes or explanations.
